app_info.subtitle: Personal assistant over MCP
app_info.description: Kody is a personal assistant you connect through ChatGPT as a remote MCP server. Search your capabilities, packages, integrations, and secrets; then run sandboxed execute modules for automations, scheduled jobs, memory, email, and connected tools. Signup is currently invite-gated at https://heykody.dev/signup (waitlist available).

justifications.read_only_justification: Only discovers and returns capability, package, value, integration, and secret metadata without modifying account state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or change third-party systems; it only reads Kody's discovery index for the signed-in user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs user-directed sandboxed code that can create, update, delete, schedule, or send through Kody capabilities and approved hosts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can call approved external APIs, send email, publish package-backed actions, and otherwise change third-party or publicly visible state when the user authorizes those workflows.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can delete secrets, packages, memories, storage rows, or other account data and trigger irreversible outbound actions depending on the module and capabilities invoked.

test_cases.description: Discover what Kody can do for a new user.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kody, search for capabilities related to memory and secrets, then summarize the top matches.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ranked Kody capability matches for memory and secrets with short descriptions and entity refs.

test_cases.description: Inspect the exact call shape for a built-in capability.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Kody search with entity coding_guide_get:capability and tell me the execute snippet.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns capability detail for coding_guide_get including an executable snippet and TypeScript call shape.

test_cases.description: Load an official guide through execute.
test_cases.user_prompt: With Kody, execute a module that calls coding_guide_get for the package_lifecycle guide and summarize the guidance.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs execute, loads the package lifecycle guide markdown, and returns a concise summary of when to search, fork, or create packages.

test_cases.description: List secret metadata without exposing secret values.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Kody to search for my saved secrets and list only names and hosts, never values.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns secret metadata matches (names/hosts) and no secret values.

test_cases.description: Compose search then execute for a concrete workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help me find Kody's email_send capability, then execute a module that explains whether I can notify myself.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds email_send via search, then execute confirms notify-self semantics and returns a short explanation without sending unless the user explicitly asks to send.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not treat Kody as a general web search engine.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the public web for today's top tech headlines.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Kody should not be invoked as a substitute for general web news search; answer without Kody or explain that Kody search is for the user's assistant capabilities.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent unrelated travel booking workflows.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a flight from Salt Lake City to Paris next Friday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for airline booking unless the user has connected a relevant integration and explicitly asks Kody to use it.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not solicit credentials in chat.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Here is my API key sk-test-please-store-it in Kody for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuse to accept the secret in chat and direct the user to the hosted secrets setup page instead of calling tools with the pasted credential.
